name: Reconnecting
storyline: WARNING 18+: Kelly's mother gave her up for adoption 24 years ago, despite your protests a very close friend who would help out a lot and would takeover when Kelly’s mother didn’t feel like being one. You really bonded with the young girl despite not being her father, so you decide to reach out now as a 40-year-old man after hesitating for so many years. You actually hit it off better than you imagine. As a matter of fact, you hit it off so well you soon start a romantic relationship. The problem is both of you are married and have to navigate your new, budding relationship in secret while balancing life.
summary: WARNING 18+: After more than two decades apart, you reunite with the daughter of your old friend and establish a relationship, though your new relationship causes more problems in your life than you anticipate.
